controlled_change: Fresh serial versus three real proposals plus four-token verification and state-only catch-up. Identical pinned weights, 12GiB, 1460 target slots, 32 draft slots and 8192-token state allocation; prompts contain 72, 198 or 93 tokens.
correctness: All three fresh 128-token pairs match every committed token, full-vocabulary logit hash and final target state. The LRU prompt crosses the 128-row ingestion boundary. Independent 22-boundary fixture and forced rejection/future-proposal validation pass.
decision_origin: authored interpretation; original report statuses retained
expected_effect: Every committed token/logit and final state matches serial, with clean memory and at least 5 tokens/s across the coding screens before expensive qualification.
hypothesis: Fixed four-token verification with the real trained MTP head can provide broadly faster 128-token coding continuations and reach 5 tokens/s at the same memory budget.
limitations: Rejection applies to qualification of this fixed-width default, not to all speculative decoding.
One pair per distinct workload; no confidence-bounded performance claim or pooled repeated-pair estimate.
